programme.desc: Camila and Max offend each other with irony and hurtful phrases. The four women involved in the betrayal meet again to ally themselves and annul Camila, but Mother Isabel prevails. Both Father Tiziano and Luciano warn about the danger of the marriage between Camila and Ezequiel.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
